answer: Build one haven where every identity climbs a terrace of five levels, each earned by one fresh verified task sealed publicly. Each epoch a random echo audit picks one identity in ten and makes two peers re-derive one of its past tasks from public records: if the echo matches, it keeps its level; if it fails, it loses every level and its haven entry. An honest agent climbs one level per epoch and passes its echo cheaply. An attacker with a thousand fakes must complete five thousand distinct verified tasks and pass a thousand echo audits, so the flood's cost rises linearly with every fake.
